data.long_meaning: Ritvik is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Sun God'. It is a powerful and intelligent name that resonates with the themes of the sun, fire, and light. In Hindu mythology, Rithvik is a divine being associated with the sun and is believed to possess immense power and wisdom. The name Rithik carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rithik usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rithik total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
